A celebration of the human spirit, the National Medal of Honor Museum honors the inspiring lives and legacies of ordinary Americans who took extraordinary action in the service of others.Over 40 million Americans have served in the US Armed Forces since the Civil War. Fewer than 4,000 have received the Medal of Honor. Before they were national heroes, they were neighbors, newlyweds, parents, students, and friends. NTT INDYCAR SERIES Toyota GR Cup INDY NXT by Firestone USF Pro 2000 Learn More Java House Grand Prix of Arlington FAQs When is the Java House Grand Prix of Arlington? March 15, 2026 Where will the race be? On the streets of the Entertainment District of Arlington, Texas surrounding AT&T Stadium and Globe Life Field. What type of racing will this event include? The NTT INDYCAR SERIES, INDY NXT by Firestone and Toyota GR Cup Series. Additional support events will be announced at a later date. How long is the track and how many turns? 2.73 miles with 14 turns. How many laps will the race be? The race distance is 70 laps. When will tickets be on sale? Tickets for the Java House Grand Prix of Arlington are on sale. View ticket options here. How do I receive updates about this event? Sign up HERE to receive news and information about the event.
